headline: Watsco keeps growing but margins normalize off a tough comp
summary_short: Watsco's Q2 2026 revenue rose 2.1% y/y to $2,104.9M (1% same-store) but diluted EPS fell 11.5% y/y to $4.00 as gross margin compressed to 27.5% from 29.3% a year ago on the fading benefit of 2025's outsized OEM pricing and tariff actions.
summary_long: Revenue grew 2% y/y (1% same-store) as 5% domestic residential HVAC equipment growth and 19% commercial-refrigeration growth offset a 1% decline in other HVAC products. Gross margin fell to 27.5% from 29.3% as 2025's outsized OEM pricing/tariff benefit (~130bps) normalized in 2026; SG&A rose 3% to 16.6% of sales. Operating income fell 12% to $238M and diluted EPS fell 12% to $4.00. The company closed the ~$230M-annualized-revenue Jackson Supply acquisition in June, adding 25 Sunbelt locations. Balance sheet remained debt-free with $464M in cash and cash investments; H1 operating cash flow improved $164M y/y to a $21M use. No forward guidance was issued in the release.
